the Formal Spaces lemma that a local property of arrows defines a property of morphisms (formal-spaces-lemma-property-defines-property-morphisms) in its Noetherian variant (formal-spaces-remark-variant-Noetherian)
core_obligations: Prove the equivalence of: (1) f is rig-smooth; (2) all etale affine probes U over V give rig-smooth arrows U to V in WAdm^Noeth; (3) some cover of Y and covers of the base changes give rig-smooth arrows; (4) some cover of X factors through etale maps toward Y with rig-smooth arrows
proof_roadmap: The equivalence of (1) and (2) is exactly the definition of rig-smooth.

The equivalences among (2), (3) and (4) follow from rig-smoothness being a local property of arrows of WAdm^Noeth together with the property-defines-property-morphisms template in its Noetherian variant.
difficulty_reason: H2: a characterization template proof that instantiates the local-property-of-arrows lemma for rig-smoothness.
